verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships a CLI, an MCP server, and AI agent features, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry controls or opting out of usage tracking. Adjacent features don't count: suppressing or deleting end-user profiles, synthetic email relays for data residency, and audit logs all concern customer data handling, not the user's own telemetry.
